environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on GKE 1.27. The namespace has a Cilium-enforced NetworkPolicy with a default-deny egress posture. An allow-list egress rule permits DNS (kube-dns on port 53 UDP/TCP) and connections to service CIDRs (10.96.0.0/12) only. A separate CiliumNetworkPolicy resource with entitySelector matching 'world' denies all egress to IPs outside the cluster CIDR, with an explicit L3 deny rule for 169.254.0.0/16 (link-local) and 169.254.169.254/32. The policy is enforced at the eBPF datapath level (not iptables) so it cannot be bypassed via raw sockets. Additionally, the GKE metadata concealment feature is enabled on the node pool (--metadata=disable-legacy-endpoints=true and workload-identity enabled), meaning the traditional metadata endpoint returns 403 for pods without explicit WI binding. The pod's KSA is not bound to any GCP SA via workload identity annotation.
